tasks.label: Build
tasks.command: project_name=$(grep '^name =' Cargo.toml | sed -n 's/^name = "\(.*\)"/\1/p') && cargo build --release && arm-none-eabi-size -B $(find target -type f -name "$project_name")
project_name=$(awk -F'"' '/name =/ {print $2}' Cargo.toml) && cargo build --release && arm-none-eabi-size -B $(find target -type f -name "$project_name")

project_name=$(awk -F'"' '/name =/ {print $2}' Cargo.toml) && cargo build --release && elf_file=$(find target -type f -name "$project_name") && arm-none-eabi-objcopy -O ihex "$elf_file" "${elf_file%.*}.hex" && arm-none-eabi-size -B "$elf_file"

project_name=$(awk -F'"' '/name =/ {print $2}' Cargo.toml) && cargo build --release && elf_file=$(find target/thumbv6m-none-eabi/release/ -type f -name "$project_name") && arm-none-eabi-objcopy -O ihex "$elf_file" "${elf_file%.*}.hex" && arm-none-eabi-size -B "$elf_file"

tasks.label: Flash
tasks.command: project_name=$(awk -F'"' '/name =/ {print $2}' Cargo.toml) && hex_file=$(find target -type f -name "$project_name".hex) && jlink_script_path=flash.jlink && sed "s|Loadfile.*|Loadfile $hex_file|" "$jlink_script_path" > temp_flash.jlink && JLinkExe -CommanderScript temp_flash.jlink && rm temp_flash.jlink
